The '''Bu Dynasty''' was the dynastic predecessor state to the [[People's Federation of Xanaqu]]. The extracted source identifies it as the old regime challenged by [[Xun Tao]] and the [[Taoist Party]] during the political crisis that produced modern Xanaqu.

This draft preserves an open canon conflict. The defunct-nations list gives the dynasty's end as 1923, while the Xanaqu formation source describes the dynasty as declining in late 1934 and giving way to the People's Federation after the [[Xanaq Civil War]] in 1936.

== Fall ==

The Xanaqu source says that Taoist Party demonstrations against the dying dynasty began in late 1934. After the dynasty's collapse, [[General Cheng Jin]] and the [[Xanaq Republicans]] attempted to create a rival northern state.

The [[Red Army of Xanaqu|Red Army]] under Xun Tao defeated the republican forces, and the People's Federation of Xanaqu was founded in 1936.

== Open Date Conflict ==

Until confirmed, the safest reading is that 1923 may mark the beginning of dynastic breakdown or loss of effective authority, while 1934-1936 marks the final political collapse and replacement by the People's Federation. This should not be treated as final canon without user confirmation.
